buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder shall comply all the terms & conditions of RFP document. 2. Compliance and necessary supporting documents shall be submitted as detailed in the RFP document fo r evaluation. 3. Signed and scanned copy of RFP documents shall be submitted. 4. SECURITY DEPOSIT/e-PBG: Security Deposit shall be submitted for 3% of the order value in the form of B ank Guarantee/a single instalment through Account Payee Demand Draft/ Bankers Cheque/ Fixed Deposit Receipts or Bank Guarantee (including e-Bank Guarantee) from any of the scheduled commercial banks or payment online in an acceptable form within 10 days after receipt of PO valid till completion of the contrac t period plus 60 days. This security deposit shall not carry any interest and shall be returned to you only after successful complet ion of the contract. In case of poor performance/ non performance of the contractual obligation security de posit shall be forfeited. In case of non submission of Security deposit within the stipulated period, this orde r shall be liable to be cancelled.

5. ESI/Medical Insurance Coverage: For the workforce deployed by the tenderer ESI coverage is mandatory as per the Social Security Code. For the category of workforce deployed by the tenderer, where the ESI cov erage is not applicable, such workforce shall be covered by a Mediclaim policy with a coverage of minimu m Rs. 2,00,000.00 per annum per person to the workforce at the cost of Service Provider. In addition to the above, service provider shall provide Insurance coverage to the workers as defined b elow. i. Insurance Risk Coverage : The service provider shall arrange comprehensive risk coverage at their own cost to their entire work forc e. Compensation to workforce: The Service Provider shall make payment of compensation in case accidental injury in accordance with pro vision of Code of Social Security, 2020 and as amended from time to time. To grant compensation in case of death/permanent incapacitation of persons engaged by the Service Provider (Private companies, firms & contractors), due to unintended/unforeseen occurrences during maintenance, operation and provisioning of Public Services, the following may be strictly followed: a. The extent of liability, on the occurrence of any “accident” as defined under these guidelines, Departme nt shall whether or not there has been any wrongful act, neglect or default on its part and not withstanding anything contained in any other law, be liable to pay compensation to such extent as prescribed below; i. In the event of death or permanent disability resulting from loss of limbs – Rs. 10 lakhs. ii. In the event of any other permanent disability – Rs. 7 lakhs. Any compensation paid under these guidelines shall be recoverable from such service provider concerned. b. For this purpose, without limiting any of the other obligations or liabilities, the service provider concerne d shall at their own expense take and keep an Employees Compensation Insurance policy for their entire w orkforce engaged in the Contract and for all the work during the execution valid for the Contract period. c. The service provider concerned shall have to furnish originals along with premium receipts and other pa pers related thereto the concerned Contract manager/focal point and accounts (copy) within 15 days from the date of commencement of the contract. The service provider shall provide their unconditional acceptance to these guidelines in their letterhead du ly signed by their authorized signatory which is mandatory for acceptance of their offer. 6. Qualification criteria: i. The Bidder shall be a registered firm for providing paramedical staff with 5 years experience as on 31.0 3.2026. ii. They should have at least 40 Service Personnel/Manpower on their regular roles in various paramedical categories for minimum 2 years during the last five years. Necessary documentary Evidence such as PF re mittance, pay slip etc., should be Produced. iii. The Bidder should be a firm with annual turnover of at least average150 Lakhs per annum during last 3 financial years ( i.e. year ending March 2026). iv. The Bidder should have executed one work order of Rs. 1.5 Cr. or Two work orders of Rs. 85 lakhs each during last 5 years in providing the Paramedical Services to at least 40 bedded Hospital/Institute. v. Bidder shall submit solvency certificate for Rs. 60 Lakhs from any scheduled/commercial bank, issued d uring the financial year 2026-27. 7. ATC shall supersede Service specific STC which shall supersede GTC, whenever there are any conflicting provisions. The above set of terms and conditions along with the scope of work and SLA as enumerated in t his document shall be construed to be part of the Contract/Agreement between the Buyer and Service Prov ider. 8. GST: As per the notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), Dated 28.06.2017, Sl. No. 03 under chapter 99, Pure services rendered to Central Government organizations are exempted from paying GST. As per th e above notification, the current services are exempted from GST, vendors should quote without GST. 9. Total basic cost to be considered by party for submission of Bid is Rs. 3,11,93,978/- and it is arrived as p er the minimum wages of SDSC SHAR on 01.04.2026. However, minimum wages shall be revised twice in a year. Vendors considering total basic cost less than Rs. 3,11,93,978/- will not be considered for evaluatio n. 10. a) The party shall include in their quote their service charges for execution of this contract and this am ount includes their profit, administrative office expenses, uniform charges, ID Card printing, various license fees, expenses of medical checkups for worker’s fitness to duty any other managerial services char ges, Medical Insurance (Rs. 2 Lakhs) and Comprehensive Insurance (Sl.No.11 of RFP) etc. b) Service charges quoted by the service provider shall not be less than 5% .

11. Total contract value should be quoted in GeM portal as per Annexure III and price break up document ( Annexure-IV) shall be uploaded in financial document of GeM bid only. Vendor should upload duly filled An nexure-III in the financial document packet of GeM Bid. 12. Vendor should duly filled and submit Annexure - II & V otherwise offer will not be considered for evalua tion. 13. MSME Relaxation: MSME relaxation will be allowed to those MSE’s who has provided Paramedical servi ces to Hospitals as per eligibility criteria. 14. Service Providers shall ensure full compliance with all applicable labour laws, including the provisions, rules, schemes and guidelines under the four Labour Codes brought into force by the Government of India notified on 21st November 2025 and as amended from time to time i.e. Code on Wages, 2019; Industrial R elations Code, 2020; Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020; and Social Security code, 2020. 15. Seller/ Service Providers shall be responsible for ensuring compliance of all notified and enforceable pr ovisions of the new Labour Codes. 16. Any non-compliance shall constitute a breach of the contract and shall entitle the Department to take appropriate action in accordance with applicable law i.e., forfeitur e of security deposit, imposition of penalty, debarment for a period not exceeding two/three years as appli cable as per Rule 151 of GFR 2017 or as per latest guidelines amended from time to time. 17. All statutory Documents and Returns shall be maintained (up to date) by the service provider as per the labour codes and to be provided to the contract manager as and when called for but not limited to. • Employee Register in Form I; • Register of Wages, Overtime, Advances, Fines and Deductions for Damage and Loss in Form IV; and • Attendance Register-cum-Muster Roll in Form IX. • Register of Women Employees in Form XXII • Single Annual Return – Unified Annual Return through shram Suvidha web portal etc. . 3. Generic The buyer organization is an institution eligible for concessional rates of GST as notified by the Government of India. The services for which bids have been invited fall under classification of GST concession and the conditions for eligibility of concession are met by the institution. A certificate to this effect will be issued by Buyer to the Seller after award of the Contract. Sellers are requested to submit their bids after accounting for the Concessional rate of GST. Applicable Concessional rate of GST : 0 % Notification No.and date : 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 28/06/2017
